summary: Iter62 — AKKI Solve Wave 2 (Handoff Trio) + Wave 3 (Triangulation v2) verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed against live LLM (~3:26 wall-time). Frontend: picker shows 'Continue where you were' + 'Completed — hand off ready' sections; HandoffStrip + ComparablesPanel render correctly on completed sessions; clicking handoff buttons fires API and visually marks emerald with toast; ComparablesPanel renders new corpus shape (sector_tag, scale_tag, diagnosis_summary, what_worked, what_didnt). Free-grant flow validated: monthly free deep-synthesis grant claimable once per UTC month, second pro synthesis falls back to standard tier.
critical_code_review_comments: solve_engine.py is large (931 lines) — consider splitting Wave 2 handoff endpoints (lines 330-700) into solve_handoffs.py for maintainability before Wave 4. Not blocking now.

_consume_free_grant relies on duplicate-key insert exception to detect already-claimed grants — clean, but only works if a unique compound index on (account_id, month_utc) exists. Confirmed via server.py:247-280 startup index ensure block — good. If that ensure block ever regresses, two pro syntheses in the same race would BOTH succeed; suggest making it explicit with find_one_and_update upsert pattern as a defence in depth.

HandoffStrip on the frontend determines 'done' state from session.handoffs[] on first render but only refetches via api.get('/solve/sessions/{id}') AFTER a successful click. If a session is opened that already has handoffs from a prior visit, the emerald state is correctly hydrated from session.handoffs — confirmed visually (Brief was already emerald before click in second test pass).

Comparables corpus has 18 entries across 12 clusters — board_dynamics has only 1 (sector_tag='any'); revenue_underperformance has 3. Coverage is uneven. Consider topping up sparse clusters (people_conduct, ma_thesis, founder_transition each have 1) to ensure at-least-2 comparables for any cluster. Currently the engine still returns 2 because _pick_comparables limits to 3 and we have at-least 2 most of the time — but for board_dynamics the test would fail if a session were started in that cluster. Bramuel's seeded data didn't trigger this edge case; flag for future hardening.

Frontend ComparablesPanel handles both string and object comparable shapes (legacy fallback). Good defensive coding. Visual confirmed: sector + scale tags render in muted overline, Worked/Didn't render with distinct accent vs muted styling.

_record_handoff persists both into solve_handoffs collection AND pushes onto solve_sessions.handoffs[] array. This dual-write is intentional (denormalised for fast list rendering on session GET) — confirmed both paths consistent in Wave 2 tests.

Cycle handoff parses 'Walk in with' line into 1-3 questions; current implementation seems to insert questions tagged with solve_session_id directly (test_handoff_cycle_creates_questions_and_idempotent passed, idempotent on 2nd call). No issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — picker + completed view + HandoffStrip + ComparablesPanel + handoff click→emerald visually verified end-to-end against live LLM-backed sessions
